searchText: Is there a canonical list of light client implementations and approaches? What I have found so far - eth2/consensus LC based: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/tree/dev/specs/altair/light-client - https://github.com/lightclients/kevlar - https://github.com/a16z/helios - https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/tree/unstable/packages/light-client - LES based light clients and ultra light clients - I haven't found any specific client that implements this - Afaik this is broken since the merge - this model has issues around incentives/compensations — why would a node spend resources to serve these requests - p2p based solution aka portal network - My understanding is that it's still very much in research state - https://nimbus.team/docs/fluffy.html - https://github.com/ethereum/trin - https://github.com/ethereumjs/ultralight Are there any other categories that I am missing? Is there any official documentation about these efforts? (If not would it make sense to put effort into creating one?) https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/nodes-and-clients/#light-node - I have read this page, helped understanding the very basics but after that it took me bit of time to understand how these releate to each other. might be useful to track how other ecosystems are approaching this as well: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/11863 thanks for the tip. My head is already spinning but makes sense 🙂

Is there a canonical list of light client implementations and approaches?

What I have found so far
- eth2/consensus LC based: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/tree/dev/specs/altair/light-client
  - https://github.com/lightclients/kevlar
  - https://github.com/a16z/helios
  - https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/tree/unstable/packages/light-client
- LES based light clients and ultra light clients
  - I haven't found any specific client that implements this 
  - Afaik this is broken since the merge 
  - this model has issues around incentives/compensations — why would a node spend resources to serve these requests 
- p2p based solution aka portal network 
  - My understanding is that it's still very much in research state 
  - https://nimbus.team/docs/fluffy.html
  - https://github.com/ethereum/trin
  - https://github.com/ethereumjs/ultralight

Are there any other categories that I am missing? 
Is there any official documentation about these efforts? (If not would it make sense to put effort into creating one?)
https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/nodes-and-clients/#light-node - I have read this page, helped understanding the very basics but after that it took me bit of time to understand how these releate to each other.
